Prerequisite (only edge): restoring_wire -> late_funding_fee, form state. Sentence verbatim in the blocked policy's hub; absent from all late-fee documents. Resolution basis: the state "the funding ledger carries the late funding fee owed for every regular payroll batch whose funds arrived after its funding deadline" + late_funding_fee_debits "The late funding fee is booked ... when that batch's funds arrived after its funding deadline; it is debited ... as a fee of the `late_funding` kind pointing to the batch" + records (batch d744efa5, receipt 0b2eba08 05:40 on the pay date, no late_funding row pointing to d744efa5). Strength: hard gate in both.

Base policies: funding deadlines/methods (funding_deadlines_and_methods, funding_payments), reserve (prefunding_reserve, reserve_standards), payroll loads (payroll_batch_loading, payroll_load_limits), fees (program_fee_billing, monthly_fee_schedule, funding_charges_schedule), lifecycle (program_lifecycle), EWA bundle (access_bundle_kit_terms, card_kit_price_list) are carried; retired clauses (funding rule 4, reserve clauses 1 and 3, billing (f), lifecycle L4) are each written as no longer in force with the surviving content restated; no undeclared retirement found.
